description: Weather prevented departure from Devon Island on the scheduled day. The entire northern Arctic was affected — the commercial flight was cancelled and the charter unable to land.
response: Crew spent an extra day in a holding pattern, completing winterisation tasks during the delay. Departed on Day 11 via an early morning charter window.
lesson: Plan departure readiness to be achievable within 2 hours from any point in the final 3 mission days. Never leave winterisation tasks for the scheduled departure day.
